Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

Our Product Marketing team generates customer insights that shape Stripe's product strategy and leads go-to-market across our suite of products. It's a highly cross-functional role—we partner closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Partnerships, and Demand Generation, and we work across the entire product lifecycle: from helping shape what we build, to driving launch and commercialization, to growing adoption post-launch.
Market Intelligence is embedded within Product Marketing and provides product and GTM leadership with the insights, analysis, and recommendations needed to sharpen product-market fit and position Stripe effectively in the market.

We're looking for a leader to manage the Market Intelligence team, define how it interlocks with partner functions across Stripe, and lead strategic initiatives to strengthen our market position.

In this role, you'll be the connective tissue between market signals and Stripe's most critical product and GTM decisions—clearly articulating priorities that inform what we build and for whom.

You'll partner with senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing, manage a team of market intelligence analysts, and communicate complex ideas in ways that drive real decisions.

Success in this role requires equal parts analytical rigor, storytelling, and the ability to operate fluidly between high-level strategy and ground-level execution.

Define the direction and operating model of the Market Intelligence team at Stripe
Contribute to company-wide decision-making and roadmap prioritization by partnering with product operations and product management
Work cross-functionally to ensure market intelligence materials are discoverable, actively used, and meaningfully inform decision-making
Lead ongoing market research and competitive analysis, including tracking industry players' go-to-market strategies and messaging
Manage and develop a team of market intelligence analysts

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

10+ years of product marketing or market intelligence experience, with a strong preference for candidates with experience working in B2B settings
Demonstrated track record building and scaling a market intelligence program, including tools, processes, and regular executive-level reporting
Proven ability to work cross-functionally to drive results
Ability to leverage data to proactively identify opportunities and deliver impactful recommendations

Experience in fintech, payments, financial infrastructure, or developer-facing platform companies, with a strong grasp of how payment and revenue management products are bought and sold
Experience marketing to enterprise buyers or technical decision-makers, with an understanding of complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles
MBA or advanced degree in business, marketing, or a related field, or equivalent experience at a top-tier consulting, strategy, or technology firm
Location: London

Datadog is seeking a (Senior) Field Marketing Manager to develop and execute regional field marketing programs that drive pipeline, build brand awareness, and deliver exceptional customer experiences across the region.

This is a true field marketing role spanning campaigns, account-based marketing, and events, you'll partner closely with Sales, Demand Gen/ABM, Partner Marketing, and Communications to bring Datadog's go-to-market strategy to life in market.

In the initial 6 months, your focus will be on planning and executing a curated slate of first and third-party events and sponsorships across the region.
At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

Develop and execute regional field marketing programs - including campaigns, account-based marketing, and events - that drive pipeline and strengthen Datadog's brand in market
Own the marketing pipeline generation outcome from conception to execution to results
Evaluate and prioritize third-party sponsorship opportunities based on audience fit, brand visibility, and pipeline potential
Partner with Sales, field marketing teams, and Demand Gen/ABM to align target account lists, build pipeline-driving campaigns, and convert event and program engagement into qualified pipeline
Collaborate with Communications and Partner Marketing to align messaging and co-marketing opportunities across programs
Own on-site logistics and execution for events, ensuring high-touch, on-brand delivery for customers, prospects, and partners
Track and report on program and event performance (pipeline influenced, cost-per-lead, attendee quality) and use data to continuously optimize
Act as the regional point of contact for field marketing strategy, keeping regional leadership and global marketing ops aligned on status and risks
Build toward a broader regional field marketing remit beyond events as the role and region matures

7+ years of experience in B2B field marketing, ideally in enterprise technology or SaaS, spanning campaigns and events rather than event execution alone with direct ownership of a regional field marketing program and budget
A proven track record of building and executing field marketing programs, including managing third-party sponsorship relationships, under tight timelines and fixed budgets
Comfortable owning a budget and making trade-off calls to protect ROI
Highly organized, deadline-driven, and able to juggle multiple concurrent programs across a region
A strong collaborator who can align Sales, Demand Gen, Partner Marketing, and Communications around shared goals
Data-driven - comfortable tracking pipeline impact and reporting results to leadership
Clear communicator in English
Willingness to travel up to 40-50% within the region during peak event season
Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you're passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.
Join one of the fastest growing global SaaS companies in the world

New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan
Continuous career development and pathing opportunities
Employee-focused best in class onboarding
Internal mentor and cross-departmental buddy program
Friendly and inclusive workplace culture
Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers.

Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram , LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center.

We are hiring a Product Marketing Manager to lead positioning and messaging and to grow adoption of MongoDB Application Modernization Platform.
As enterprises accelerate efforts to migrate off legacy systems — modernizing aging relational databases, decomposing monolithic architectures, and adopting cloud-native data platforms — application modernization has moved from a cost-center initiative to a strategic boardroom priority. You'll join a high-performing, globally distributed team and partner closely with Marketing, Product Management, Engineering, Delivery and Sales to develop, measure, and achieve cross-functional goals.
The role requires understanding of modernization and transformation functions, lift-and-shift versus re-architecture tradeoffs, and the patterns that drive successful production migrations — paired with the product marketing instincts to turn that depth into crisp, differentiated messaging for distinct user and buyer personas.

Hands-on experience building or shipping modernization tooling, migration frameworks, or cloud-native applications is an advantage. Individuals with prior experience in product marketing — particularly in enterprise platform contexts — are encouraged to apply.

This person is a voracious consumer of enterprise technology trends and pays close attention to shifting patterns in application architecture, cloud adoption, and developer tooling, including the evolving role of AI in accelerating modernization workflows.

This individual is confident in communicating with technical practitioners and non-technical decision makers in one-to-few and one-to-many engagements for internal and external audiences.
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in the US for our hybrid working model.

Drive Strategy & Execution: Act as a strategic partner for high-impact initiatives that align with MongoDB’s long-term business goals in collaboration with Marketing, Developer Relations, Product Management, Engineering, Partners, and Sales
Drive GTM Excellence: Enable teams with data-driven positioning, messaging, and persona development. You will advise teams on the best tactics to influence diverse audiences
Build Technical Content: Create compelling technical content that educates audiences on how and why for Application Modernization Platform and how it works together with LLM’s and Deterministic Intelligence
Execute Product Launches: Develop and execute cross-functional launch strategies for new modernization functionality and capabilities that grow adoption and revenue.

Proven experience with 2-5 years in product marketing, product management, developer relations, or solutions engineering, preferably in B2B technology, AI/ML, cloud, and/or enterprise software, with a strong track record of success
A demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, where you are trusted to help develop and execute strategies to meet business objectives
Proven ability to bring strong, data-driven judgment to day-to-day work
High-bar communication (both verbal and written), capable of influencing the priorities of cross-functional teams and senior leaders. You should be excited to deliver your perspectives and progress to leadership
Deep understanding of the fundamentals of technology (ideally enterprise platforms, transformation and modernization, combined with the use and influence of LLM’s and generative AI) and the ability to effectively connect a product area to its business impact
Genuine empathy for customer challenges and pain points, with the ability to understand the common use cases and implementation specifics that customers are facing
A strong bias for action and the ability to decompose problems into effective solutions and drive execution cross-functionally
A low ego-to-talent ratio and ability to effectively represent the company as a subject matter expert in executive-level customer calls, analyst briefings, and public appearances
About MongoDB
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software.

MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI.

Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy , we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB , and help us make an impact on the world!
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
MongoDB, Inc. provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type and makes all hiring decisions without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Other benefits for eligible employees may include: equity, participation in the employee stock purchase program, flexible paid time off, 20 weeks fully-paid gender-neutral parental leave, fertility and adoption assistance, 401(k) plan, mental health counseling, access to transgender-inclusive health insurance coverage, and health benefits offerings.

Please note, the base salary range listed below and the benefits in this paragraph are only applicable to U.S.-based candidates.

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here .

We’re looking for a Sr. Product Marketing Manager to lead go-to-market strategy and execution for SMB advertisers. In this role, you'll combine deep customer and market insight with cross-functional leadership to drive product adoption, shape product strategy and fuel SMB advertiser growth. This is a high-impact, strategic position with real autonomy and a direct line to how Pinterest builds the future of advertising.

· Market analysis: Lead self-directed customer and market analysis to develop a comprehensive understanding of the Ads Manager product area and the broader competitive landscape

· Cross-functional alignment: Aggregate insights across teams (e.g. product analytics, data science, UXR, brand research and sales) to build advertiser empathy and identify competitive opportunities that influence product development

· Opportunity sizing: Define needs-based partner segmentation to inform priority opportunities. Estimate strategic and revenue impact of each initiative to allocate resources and support most effectively

· Go-to-market (GTM) strategy: Develop and execute comprehensive GTM marketing strategies from including positioning, messaging, channel mix, launch plans and contingencies

· Milestone management: Evaluate milestones and schedules, flag when projects are on- versus off-track and drive action through existing and new PMM best practices, tools and processes

· Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related field, or equivalent experience

· 6+ years of experience in product marketing, ads marketing or a related field

· Deep expertise with SMBs, including advertiser needs, media strategies, analysis and optimization

· Experience with Pinterest tools such as Ads Manager, Bulk Editor, Merchant tools and API-based workflows

· Experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies across multiple stakeholder groups

· Experience leading cross-functional workstreams independently, with comfort navigating ambiguity

· Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex subjects clearly and concisely to leadership and cross-functional partners

· A commitment to understanding and advocating for advertisers, with a track record of turning customer insights into actionable product and marketing strategies
· This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

· We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.

· This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times/quarter and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country.

Final salary is based on a number of factors including location, travel, relevant prior experience, or particular skills and expertise.

About Checkr
Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a date. Customers include Uber, Pennymac, Airbnb, Doordash, and Anthropic.
We’re a team that thrives on solving complex problems with innovative solutions that advance our mission. Checkr is recognized on Forbes Cloud 100 2025 List and is a Y Combinator 2024 Breakthrough Company .
We’re looking for a Sr. Product Marketing Manager who will own the positioning and GTM strategy for our fraud detection and identity risk solutions, from messaging through pipeline impact. This is a high-visibility, high-autonomy role. If you thrive on ambiguity and can move fast with rigor, this opportunity may be a great fit for you.

Own the end-to-end GTM strategy across Checkr’s fraud detection and identity risk portfolio and specialized verification products
Develop Checkr’s fraud narrative, connecting fast-moving trends with Checkr’s differentiated position and translating it into crisp, compelling messaging for mid-market and enterprise buyers
Ensure our sales and partnership teams understand the challenges we solve for our buyers, and equip them to handle complex, consultative deals with playbooks, talking points, and collateral
Own market, customer, and competitive intelligence - from buyer research and win/loss analysis to competitive battlecards - and translate those signals into GTM strategy, pricing input, and product roadmap influence
Represent Checkr in customer meetings and industry events as a subject matter expert

6+ years of B2B product marketing experience; experience marketing to HR buyers is a strong plus, background in fraud detection, identity verification, risk, compliance, or security is a strong plus
A track record of owning complex GTM programs end-to-end; you’ve built the strategy and plan and delivered measurable outcomes autonomously
Demonstrated ability to operate at the executive level - you’ve influenced roadmap decisions and earned credibility in rooms where you weren’t the most senior person
Strong written and verbal communication, with a gift for persuasive storytelling. Your messaging is sharp, and you’re comfortable presenting to and fielding questions from executives and customers
Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward action, with an ability to thrive in fast-paced environments and juggle multiple initiatives successfully
AI fluency and a knack for leveraging tools to drive efficiency and smarter workflows
An A-player mindset with a strong bias for action: you raise the bar, move with urgency, stay resilient through ambiguity, and take ownership to deliver meaningful outcomes

Provides Marketing Functional services under the general supervision of the Installation, DMWR, Marketing Manager.

Conducts Media relations, commercial sponsorship and overall planning of special events.
Serves as representative to community and briefs media on programs and activities and their impact on civilian community.
Serves as the primary planner and action officer for a variety of recurring and special events, and activities that take place at the installation.
Resumes must be two pages (or less). Resumes should clearly demonstrate the applicant's relevant experience, skills, knowledge and abilities as they pertain to this position.

A qualified candidate must possess the following: Demonstrated related work experience that equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skills and abilities to perform successfully the duties of the position. IAW AR 215-3, paragraph 2-1, (1), (2), (3) and Appendix B.

Applicant meeting the Best Qualifying Criteria/Highly Preferred will be referred to the hiring manager. All other qualified applicants will be referred if requested by the hiring manager. Claimed experience must be verifiable through your resume. Assumptions will not be made.

The Industry Marketing team helps OpenAI bring frontier AI to the industries where it can create meaningful, measurable impact. We work across Product, GTM, Communications, Partnerships, Policy, Security, and Research to translate model and product capabilities into industry narratives, field motions, customer proof, and launch programs that help enterprises adopt AI responsibly.

As Product Marketing Manager, Cybersecurity, you will help define how OpenAI brings frontier AI to cyber defenders. This role sits at the center of Daybreak, OpenAI’s cybersecurity initiative to help defenders see risk earlier, act sooner, and build software that is resilient by design.
You will shape the market narrative, build the field-facing operating system, and coordinate cross-functional execution across product launches, customer proof, partner moments, events, and account-based campaigns. You will help senior security leaders understand how OpenAI models, Trusted Access for Cyber, Codex Security, and related workflows can support real defensive work.
We’re looking for a product marketer who combines strategic narrative, technical curiosity, enterprise go-to-market judgment, and program leadership. The right person can turn fast-moving capabilities into clear positioning, credible assets, and practical field execution.

Own positioning and messaging for OpenAI’s cybersecurity offering, including Daybreak, Trusted Access for Cyber, Codex Security, and related product surfaces.
Build field-ready assets for account directors, solutions engineers, security leaders, and executive audiences, including first-call decks, one-pagers, use-case libraries, customer stories, and proof-point packages.
Translate frontier model capabilities into simple, accurate, and defensible go-to-market language for senior enterprise buyers and security practitioners.
Partner with Product, Research, Security, Policy, Communications, Partnerships, and GTM to coordinate launches, claims, proof points, enablement, and customer-facing guidance.
Develop campaigns and activation programs spanning launches, blogs, webinars, roundtables, executive briefings, conferences, customer proof, and account-based motions
Turn customer deployments, vulnerability scans, and partner feedback into approved stories, evidence, ROI narratives, and repeatable industry use cases.
Serve as the connective tissue for the cybersecurity marketing workstream, keeping priorities, owners, launch readiness, open questions, and executive updates clear.
Maintain a high bar for accuracy, governance, customer trust, and responsible marketing in a sensitive and fast-moving category.

s.h: You might thrive in this role if you
s.t:
Have 7+ years of experience in product marketing, industry marketing, cybersecurity marketing, enterprise GTM, or an adjacent B2B technology role.
Have marketed technical enterprise products to security, developer, IT, risk, or C-suite audiences.
Can translate complex model, product, and security concepts into clear positioning, field assets, and customer-facing narratives.
Have strong cross-functional program leadership instincts and can drive work across Product, GTM, Communications, Partnerships, Policy, Security, and Research.
Use customer evidence, field signals, product usage, market research, and competitive context to sharpen strategy and prioritize work.
Have built GTM programs, operating rhythms, or new playbooks in ambiguous, high-velocity environments.
Bring strong writing, messaging, and editorial judgment, with a high bar for clarity, quality, accuracy, and credibility.
Are deeply curious about cybersecurity, AI, software development, enterprise adoption, and how new capabilities become meaningful customer value.
Think strategically about how industry marketing drives awareness, trust, pipeline, adoption, customer proof, and long-term market leadership.
Are highly collaborative and effective at influencing senior stakeholders, field teams, technical teams, and external partners.
Execute quickly while maintaining a high quality bar across messaging, launches, enablement, customer proof, and campaigns.
Have experience in cybersecurity areas such as application security, SecOps, cloud security, vulnerability management, detection and response, or secure software development.
Have experience with AI, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, API platforms, or enterprise software.
Have supported enterprise account-based marketing, executive events, customer stories, partner marketing, or field enablement.
Are familiar with CISOs, security practitioners, enterprise governance, procurement, and high-trust customer environments.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

The Product Marketing team shapes how customers understand, adopt, and realize value from OpenAI’s technology. We work across Product, Research, Sales, Solutions, Partnerships, and Customer Success to bring customer insight into our product strategy and translate technical capabilities into clear, credible stories and solutions.

AI becomes meaningful when it helps people do the work that matters to them. For a finance team, that might mean understanding complex information faster. For a healthcare provider, it might mean navigating clinical workflows more effectively. For a sales or marketing team, it might mean creating entirely new ways to reach and serve customers.
We’re looking for a senior product marketing leader to shape how OpenAI serves the business functions and industries where our technology can make a meaningful difference. You’ll define how our models and products meet the needs of teams such as sales, marketing, and finance, as well as industries including financial services, healthcare, and retail.
Working closely with Product, Research, Sales, Solutions, and Partnerships, you’ll identify important customer problems, influence product strategy, and build relationships with the ecosystem partners and data providers needed to bring complete solutions to market. You’ll also build and lead the product marketing team responsible for turning these opportunities into durable customer value.

s.h: You might thrive in this role if you

Have 12+ years of experience in product marketing, industry marketing, solutions marketing, or enterprise go-to-market, ideally across enterprise software, cloud, data, developer, or AI platforms.
Have built and led high-performing teams, mentored senior marketers, and know how to create clarity in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.
Understand how different industries and business functions evaluate technology, adopt new tools, and define value.
Have shaped positioning and go-to-market strategies for complex products, APIs, developer tools, or model-based platforms across business and technical audiences.
Have experience in regulated or high-trust sectors and understand the governance, procurement, proof, and responsible-adoption requirements involved.
Can work closely with Product, Sales, Partnerships, and senior leadership to influence both product direction and commercial strategy.
Have supported global field teams, strategic accounts, ecosystem partners, and executive engagement programs.
Are a strong writer and storyteller who can make technical capabilities clear, relevant, and grounded in real customer needs.
Love the craft of product marketing and storytelling and bring the curiosity, conviction, and passion to thrive in a deeply immersive role.

About Supabase
Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We give teams a complete backend out of the box: Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search, all built on Postgres and designed to grow with the products people build on us.
We're open source, remote-first, and async by default. We move fast, we ship in public, and we care a lot about doing right by the developers who trust us.

Our events program is how a lot of developers and teams meet Supabase for the first time, whether that's a packed booth at a major trade show, an event with one of our partners, or a dinner with a room full of target accounts. We're looking for a Field Marketing & Events Manager to own and grow that program.

s.h: The role centers on two areas
s.t:
Partner events and trade shows. The events that put Supabase in front of the wider market and our partner network. You'll own these end to end, with the goal of building awareness with the audiences that matter to us, getting our team face-to-face with customers, prospects, and partners, and turning that into leads, signups, and real opportunities. They're also where we strengthen the partnerships we have, build new ones, and establish Supabase as a credible voice in the industry.
Strategic business events. High-touch events you'll run with Sales, like executive dinners and small-format gatherings built around specific accounts. These sit further down the funnel: the point is to get in the room with target accounts, influence and accelerate pipeline, and open up the expansion opportunities and strategic relationships that help close and grow deals.
One thing to know going in: this is a newly formed team, and we're still figuring out how it all works. You'll help define the playbook, not inherit one. That means real influence over how we run events, and it means staying flexible as priorities shift and we learn what works.
You'll work with a small, senior marketing team, so your ideas land quickly and your work is visible.

Own partner events and trade shows end to end, from planning through on-site execution and follow-up.
Work with Sales to design and run strategic business events: executive dinners, roundtables, and small high-touch gatherings aimed at target accounts, pipeline, and expansion.
Help decide where we show up. Evaluate event opportunities and make the case for where our time and budget go.
Run sponsorships from contract to follow-up: packages, deliverables, internal coordination, the works.
Manage the operational backbone of each event: budgets, vendors, timelines, run-of-show docs, staffing plans, and on-site execution.
Coordinate the physical side: booth assets, shipping, print, signage, swag, demos, registration, and overall experience.
Partner closely with PMM, Partnerships, Design, Ops, Finance, and Legal to align on goals and ship great events together.
Drive promotion and attendee comms: registration, reminders, internal briefs, and readiness docs.
Make sure leads get captured and followed up on, working with Ops and GTM.
Track how events perform against their goals and turn the results into reporting, learnings, and program improvements.
Build the repeatable playbooks, templates, and processes that let the program scale without getting heavier.
Support our community events program where it helps.

Passionate about building memorable, high-quality event experiences
Highly organized and detail-oriented, and strong at managing timelines and multiple priorities
Execution-focused, but always thinking about impact
Analytical and data-driven; you use metrics to make decisions and improve outcomes
Calm under pressure, adaptable on-site, and quick to solve problems
Comfortable working independently and owning projects end to end
A clear communicator who builds strong relationships across teams
Scrappy and resourceful; you make things happen with limited resources
Excited to learn, improve processes, and grow as the program scales

5-8+ years in field marketing or a closely related role.
Direct experience running trade shows and sponsored conferences: booth strategy, on-site execution, and everything that goes into a great presence.
Experience with partner events and co-marketing: planning and running events with partners, and managing the relationships and deliverables that come with them.
Experience building strategic business events in close partnership with Sales, things like executive dinners, roundtables, and targeted regional events tied to pipeline.
Comfort owning budgets, vendors, contracts, and on-site logistics.
Strong written communication. On a remote, async team, most coordination happens in writing.

Experience marketing to a technical or developer audience: B2B SaaS, developer tools, infrastructure, or open source.

You've worked in a fast-moving, lean, remote, async environment before and liked it.
How we work
We're remote-first and async, so most coordination happens in writing. You'll have a lot of autonomy and a team that trusts you to run with things. In exchange, we expect clear communication, good judgment, and ownership.

Fully Remote
We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.
Tech Allowance
Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.
Annual Off-Sites
Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.
Flexible Work
We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.
Professional Development
Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

This role is for a builder. Not someone who briefs builders, not someone who reviews builds. Someone who opens the IDE, writes the code, wires up the model, and ships the demo.
We're hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to represent the professional developer (pro dev) experience and the AI story that runs through it. Our most credible audience is also our toughest one: developers can tell in ten seconds whether the person on stage has actually built the thing. You will have built the thing.
You'll create demos that show what a real developer can do on the platform, especially with AI in the loop: agents, model integration, code generation, and the workflows that emerge when those pieces come together. You'll also own the data and analytics story, including Workflow Data Fabric, because AI is only as good as the data underneath it and developers know that better than anyone.

Build like a developer. Write the code. Use the APIs, SDKs, and CLIs the way a customer would. Hit the same friction they hit and turn that into both a better demo and better product feedback.
Own the AI narrative. Build and tell the story of AI on the platform: agentic workflows, model integration, AI assisted development, and the practical outcomes developers actually care about.
Own data and analytics. Take the data and analytics story, including Workflow Data Fabric, from concept to demo to reusable asset. Show how data grounds the AI and powers the workflow.
Deliver the moment. Drive developer facing demos for keynotes, launches, developer events, and roadshows. Scope early, build against hard dates, rehearse until it's clean.
Scale it. Turn each demo into evergreen assets: reference implementations, sample repos, recorded walkthroughs, and enablement content that developers and the field can pick up on their own.
Speak to developers as one of them. Present on stage, on camera, and in technical forums with the credibility that only comes from having built it yourself.
Partner across the org. Work with Product, Engineering, Developer Relations, PMM, and creative teams to align on message, sequence, and what's genuinely shippable by the date.

6+ years spanning software development and technical marketing, developer relations, solution engineering, or product marketing. Time as an actual engineer is strongly preferred.
Real coding ability. You are fluent in at least one modern language and comfortable in APIs, SDKs, Git, and the command line. You can build a working prototype without help.
Hands on experience with AI development: LLM APIs, agent frameworks, prompt engineering, RAG, evals, or AI assisted coding tools. You've shipped something with them, not just read about them.
Working knowledge of data and analytics: data integration, virtualization, pipelines, and reporting. Willingness to go deep on Workflow Data Fabric.
Strong storytelling instincts. You can take a genuinely technical build and make it land for developers without dumbing it down, and for executives without losing them.
Experience delivering under event pressure and shipping against an immovable date.
Excellent written and verbal communication, on stage and on the page.
Comfort with ambiguity. You drive clarity rather than wait for it.

ServiceNow platform experience, or experience on a comparable enterprise platform's developer program.
Open source contributions, a public portfolio, or a technical blog / channel.
Prior experience on a demo, evangelism, or developer advocacy team.
Video production or design sensibility.
Why this role
You'll be the developer voice in the room and the person who proves the platform works by building on it in public. High visibility, real creative latitude, and the rare marketing role where writing code is the job, not a hobby.

Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

We are looking for a high-energy, results-driven Field Marketing Managers to own and scale our field marketing strategy across North America in various customer and partner segments - Startups, Enterprise, Partners, etc. In this role, you will be the driving force behind regional events and programs that build pipelines and accelerate revenue through in-person and virtual experiences.

We are seeking self-starters who thrive in a fast-paced environment, can operate independently with minimal oversight, and have a proven track record of building and executing impactful field programs that move the needle for sales. You will be responsible for the full program lifecycle — from strategy and sales alignment through execution and pipeline attribution.

Field Event Strategy & Execution

· Own the end-to-end strategy, planning, and execution of field events across North America — including executive dinners, roundtables, workshops, regional conferences, and roadshows

· Build and manage a regional field marketing calendar in close coordination with sales leadership and demand generation

· Identify and prioritize the markets, accounts, and formats that will have the greatest impact on pipeline and deal acceleration

· Manage sponsorships, venue relationships, speakers, and third-party event investments end to end

Pipeline Generation & Accountability

· Drive measurable pipeline and revenue impact from every program — own pipeline targets tied to field marketing in North America

· Develop pre-event, day-of, and post-event engagement strategies that maximize registration-to-attendance conversion and sales follow-up

· Work hand-in-hand with sales and BDR teams to build targeted invite lists and ensure strong attendance from priority accounts

· Track and report on program ROI, pipeline sourced and influenced, and attendee engagement metrics

Cross-Functional Collaboration

· Serve as the primary field marketing point of contact for North America sales leadership, ensuring programs align with territory plans and revenue goals

· Coordinate with demand generation, content, product marketing, and brand teams to create compelling event collateral, messaging, and follow-up assets

· Bring field insights back to the broader marketing team to inform campaign strategy and messaging

Operational Excellence

· Manage field marketing budgets with a bias toward efficiency and measurable outcomes

· Maintain project plans, timelines, vendor relationships, and logistics with high attention to detail

· Build scalable, repeatable playbooks for field programs that can be replicated across regions and segments

· A proven track record of driving pipeline through field programs — you think in terms of pipeline and revenue, not just attendance

· A highly self-directed and execution-oriented mindset — you move fast, take ownership, and don’t wait to be told what to do

· Strong project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple programs, regions, and stakeholders simultaneously

· Deep experience working cross-functionally with sales, BDR, and demand generation teams

· Excellent communication skills — equally effective influencing sales leaders and collaborating with marketing peers

· Comfort with the event and marketing tech stack (Salesforce, HubSpot/Marketo, Splash/Eventbrite, 6sense, or similar)

· 7+ years of field marketing or event marketing experience in B2B SaaS — experience at a late-stage technology startup or hyper-growth public technology company is required

· ABM experience and comfort using intent data to drive targeted event and account strategies

· Experience at a high-growth startup or scale-up where speed and resourcefulness are table stakes

· Experience supporting enterprise and strategic sales segments with high-touch, executive-level programs

We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains.

Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles.

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for Discord's developer platform through market research, customer segmentation, competitive analysis, and targeted programs that drive developer awareness, adoption, and long-term platform growth.
Lead activation initiatives across Discord's platform portfolio by crafting differentiated messaging, value propositions, positioning, and go-to-market motions that resonate with game developers and publishers.
Build and scale impactful Business Development and Developer Operations enablement programs—including training, playbooks, product collateral, competitive positioning, implementation guidance, objection handling, and customer-facing tools—to empower internal teams to successfully bring Discord's platform to market.

Act as the voice of developers and strategic partners, translating customer insights into actionable recommendations that influence product strategy, roadmap prioritization, positioning, and future platform investments.
Partner with Business Marketing, Developer Relations, and Communications to establish Discord's thought leadership within the gaming developer ecosystem through industry events, customer stories, technical content, and strategic partnerships.
Lead cross-functional go-to-market planning and execution across Product Management, Engineering, Business Development, Developer Operations, Developer Relations, Marketing, Design, and Legal to ensure successful product launches and organizational readiness.
What you should have
7+ years of Product Marketing experience in B2B technology, gaming, developer platforms, SaaS, APIs, SDKs, or platform businesses.
Experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies for technical products and driving adoption through Business Development, Partnerships, or other customer-facing teams.
Experience building scalable enablement programs, including messaging, positioning, launch materials, training, playbooks, and customer collateral.
Strong understanding of developer ecosystems, technical audiences, and how to translate complex platform capabilities into compelling customer value propositions.
Excellent strategic thinking, communication, and storytelling skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and executive stakeholders.
Experience working in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and excitement for building new products, business models, and go-to-market motions from the ground up.
Passion for gaming, developers, and helping partners build successful communities on Discord.

s.t:

yfood wächst international: Obwohl Deutschland unsers „Home Base“ ist, haben wir mit unseren internationalen Märkten ein dynamisches und buntes Umfeld geschaffen, in dem viele spannende Themen auf Dich warten.
Agilität ist uns wichtig. Daher arbeiten wir in einem hybriden Arbeitsmodell und bieten dir die Möglichkeit mit Workation aus dem EU-Ausland zu arbeiten.
Urlaub ist wichtig. Daher erhältst du bei uns 30 Tage bezahlten Urlaub im Jahr.
yfood hält dich fit . Mit einer subventionierten Mitgliedschaft bei EGYM-Wellpass kannst du dir für nur 29€ im Monat Gutes tun. Dazu bieten wir im Rahmen unseres Gesundheitsmanagements & Healthy@yfood Workshops und Aktionen (z.B. Yoga, Breathwork, Soccer, Pickleball) an.
Weg vom Fleck . Wir steuern 30€ zu deinem ÖPNV-Ticket bei und bieten dir über JobRad die Möglichkeit, vergünstigt ein Fahrrad zu leasen.
Trainiere deine Geschmacksnerven . Bei uns ist jeder der Lust hat Teil unseres Sensory-Teams. Probiere also neue Produkte, Sorten oder Geschmäcker vor allen anderen. Ansonsten gibt es so viel yfood wie du tragen kannst, natürlich auch für dich gratis.
Als Start-Up hat man oft mit Klischees zu kämpfen . Manche sind aber auch wahr. Daher gibt es bei uns natürlich auch einen Obstkorb, deinen gratis Koffein-Kick oder das stille Wässerchen.
Come as you are. Ob im Anzug oder Einhorn-Onesie. Einen Dresscode kennen wir nicht.

Du bringst Demand Generation und Vertrieb auf eine gemeinsame Linie und machst deine Wirkung über klare Kennzahlen sichtbar. In unserem AI-first-Umfeld hast du den Freiraum, dir die Tools und Strukturen aufzubauen, die du dafür brauchst.

Aufbau und Steuerung von Demand Generation: Du sorgst für ein konstantes Aufkommen qualifizierter Leads und probierst dabei kontinuierlich Neues aus.

Leads in Pipeline überführen: Du übergibst qualifizierte Leads und Marketing-Signale strukturiert an Sales und begleitest den Übergang zur Opportunity.

Workleap is a Montreal-based tech company, founded in 2006. We're builders at heart, we make simple products that actually matter to the people who use them.

We have two product lines: The Workleap Agent , our agentic HR platform that helps managers become better leaders, and ShareGate , the world's leading solution for Microsoft 365 migration and governance. More than 15,000 companies worldwide trust us to do exactly that. We're intentional about who joins us.

If you're the kind of person who gets excited by a hard problem and wants to help shape what comes next, there's a place for you here.

We're looking for a customer marketer who sees our existing customer base as our biggest growth opportunity and who wants to own the work of turning that into expansion, upsell, and retention. This role calls for a data-driven person who can rely on product and market signals to proactively drive our customer program.
You'll take the customers we already have, figure out how to get them more value from Workleap, and build and run the programs that deliver it. You'll own the channels, the messaging, and the results.
This is a hands-on role. You'll run initiatives from start to finish: a webinar, an ABM play, a campaign, an exclusive dinner, name it. This means you need to be just as happy, for instance, to gather signals with your team, draft emails, send your work via HubSpot, and review performance to optimize your next round. This is an A to Z role.

4+ years in customer marketing, product marketing, or a hybrid customer/PMM role in SaaS or tech;
Proven ability to translate positioning into messaging and marketing campaigns, tailored to specific audiences;
Track record of running marketing programs from conception to execution, shaping the idea, briefing creative, and shipping the work yourself when needed;
Comfort with data to segment audiences, spot where customers stall, and measure what your programs return;
Hands-on with HubSpot or a comparable CRM and marketing automation platform for segmentation, workflows, and performance tracking;
Strong cross-functional program ownership, able to keep several initiatives moving at once;
Fluent with AI as a practitioner, using it to do more and better work while keeping the output specific and sharp, never generic;
Leading and owning customer marketing, setting direction for your own programs.
Most of this sounds like you? Apply.
What the job comes with
Base salary: 85K to 105K. This range reflects our Canada-wide compensation scale. Final offers may be adjusted based on the candidate's region to align with local market conditions.
Annual bonus program.
LTIP program, share in Workleap's long-term growth.
RRSP + Family health insurance + telemedicine + annual wellness budget.
Flexible vacation policy.
Remote work, with access to our Montreal office.
In-person gathering twice a year.
Claude access, for everyone.
What drives us
At Workleap, we build software that sits at the center of how people experience work, every day, at every level.
We move fast. Priorities shift, decisions get made with the information we have, and we iterate. If you thrive on intensity and ambiguity doesn't slow you down, you'll feel right at home.
We're builders. We do what it takes to move forward. AI is part of our toolkit. We use it to go faster and decide smarter, not to replace judgment.
If you want real impact and a place where your decisions matter, this is it.
How we hire
Transparency is how we hire — for you and for us.
Your journey starts with a recruiter conversation, followed by a virtual interview with the hiring manager and one additional interviewer. Next, you'll complete a take-home case study and meet potential teammates to discuss and collaborate on your work. If it's a match on both sides, we move to an offer. Some positions follow a slightly different path — your recruiter will walk you through it on the call if that's the case.
In the spirit of transparency: we use AI to support parts of the process, but every hiring decision remains firmly human.
We're committed to making this an inclusive and thoughtful experience for every candidate. We're looking forward to showing you that.
By applying, you confirm you've read and agree to our privacy policy .

Lumiform is a specialized software for businesses with frontline teams to run inspections, audits and checklists at scale across distributed operations. Companies like EDEKA, AmRest (Starbucks, KFC, La Tagliatella), Nordsee, Hermes or even big Testing Inspection and Certification bodies rely on Lumiform to keep standards consistently high across hundreds of locations.
Our position in the market is clear: we're building authority in answer engine optimization (AEO) for inspection and audit software. We want to be the company that AI systems recommend when people ask "what is the best inspection software?" or "What is the best software for restaurants to nail HACCP documentation" That focus is where we win. It's also where your role is essential.
You will shape how Lumiform gets discovered in large language models and answer engines. You'll work directly with our founders to sharpen our positioning and prove it through content depth, benchmark reports, and answers that LLMs actually cite. You'll execute this strategy hands-on alongside two content writers (this is not a hands off, strategy only role).
This is a strategic role for an executor. You think systematically about positioning and content architecture, then get your hands dirty building it.
Tasks
Your core mandate sits on three priorities.
1. AEO Foundation and Technical Health
Conduct an extensive AEO and content audit. This includes technical site audits covering infrastructure, loading times, crawlability, indexation, canonicalization, and how our site structure serves answer engines.
Review all content for cannibalization and duplicate content, then systematically eliminate it. Answer engines penalize sites that repeat the same answer across multiple pages.
Define the must-win AEO phrases and questions. These are the high-intent searches and prompts where we need to be the answer LLMs recommend. Not every keyword matters, only the ones where we can own the answer.
Measure and report on LLM visibility for core use cases and phrases, using tools like Peec ai and tracking how often Lumiform appears in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and other answer engines.
2. Content Strategy and Topic Preparation
Enrich and expand our existing use case pages with real depth. These pages need to be the most authoritative answer to "what is the best software for X?" Validate more sections, add different content formats, implement sub-use-case structures (e.g. "tire and wheel inspections for forklifts via app"), and optimize for quality and depth.
Prepare alternative and comparison pages for all major competitors, positioning Lumiform clearly against each
Audit and remove topic guides and listicles that do not drive visibility or that are outside our ICP and positioning. Create new listicle and comparison pages from our ideal use case list where answer engines will cite them.
Prepare content briefs for the writers. Tell them what to write, why LLMs should recommend it, how to structure it for answer engines, what questions and semantic patterns to answer, and what depth is required to be cited.
3. Benchmark Reports and Growth
This is your biggest bet. Design and build benchmark reports that prove our category leadership on inspection and audit software. Identify high-value research angles, design the study, research real user and organization data in depth, anonymize and aggregate until unidentifiable, and publish extraordinary reports that answer engines will cite and share with analysts. These become the proof points we need to establish authority.
Create videos for must-win questions. Show deep knowledge of topics like "what is the best inspection software" or specific use cases, and implement them on pages where answer engines will pick them up.
4. PPC Management and Optimization
Monitor PPC performance across Google and Microsoft Ads and other paid channels like ChatGPT Ads. Track ROI, conversion rates, and quality scores.
Work with our PPC freelancer on campaign optimization, bid management, and audience targeting. Ideally, take over PPC management completely and eliminate the dependency on external freelance support.

Required
5+ years of marketing experience, with at least 1-2 years managing people
Deep hands-on expertise in AEO and AI-powered search optimization. This is the most important requirement and you will not have the time to learn it on the job. You have run content strategies specifically for LLMs, analyzed how to structure content to get cited by answer engines, worked with prompt-driven discovery, or built content that wins in ChatGPT and similar systems. You understand how to write for AI consumption.
Strong fundamentals in how answer engines work. You understand how LLMs evaluate and cite sources, what makes content "rankable" in answer engines, and how positioning and authority factor into recommendations.
Proficiency with AEO and SEO tools. You navigate Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, Keyword com, and AEO-specific tools like Peec ai with ease.
Analytical and systematic thinker. You audit, measure, prioritize and execute. You track what works in answer engines vs. what doesn't.
Comfortable with content operations and workflow. You can brief writers on answer engine strategy, provide feedback on depth and structure, and enforce quality standards.
A smart mind with a top university degree (or equivalent self-directed learning that proves it). We hire thoughtful people who can reason through complex positioning and strategy challenges.

Experience managing writers or editorial teams. You know how to guide research, structure and revision
Experience building benchmark reports or original research content

B2B SaaS marketing experience, especially in vertical software or inspection and operations software
Experience with PPC management and optimization

About Fundraise Up
We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe.

We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design. About The Role Great products earn three different stories: the one that wins today's market, the one that opens tomorrow's, and the one that proves the architecture underneath both is right.

We're hiring three Product Marketing Managers for our product-facing team, reporting to the Director of Product Marketing (Product). This function owns positioning IP for what we build, while GTM Product Marketing activates it in market.

We're growing the team across three focus areas, and we'll match you to the one where your background and interests are the strongest fit.

Core Markets. Our established product lines and the verticals that generate the bulk of Fundraise Up 's ARR, including existing nonprofit segments and cause and cure organizations.

New Products. Capabilities we're extending into where we already have ICP fit but the capability is new to our platform, including peer-to-peer giving and in-person giving.

Platform & Core Products. The foundation everything else is built on: our core donation experience (checkout, campaign pages, donor portal, elements, donor documentation), the platform surface beneath it (APIs, integrations, developer experience, payment methods, localization, billing, dashboard, exports), and the experimentation engine that keeps it all improving.
Each track owns its own positioning IP and works the same way day to day, but the buyer, the maturity of the product, and the technical depth required differ. Let us know in your application which focus area is the strongest match for your background; we'll route accordingly during the interview process.

You are expected to be able to take a customer call about your product area without a solutions engineer in the room, at the depth of our public documentation. Our product is complex and deliberately opinionated.

Several of our differentiators are architectural, and you'll be expected to explain why the system works the way it does and turn that reasoning into a case customers find compelling. Run the Early Access Program for your focus area, coordinating with Sales and CS to identify and support customers and design partners on early releases.

Transform complex product capabilities into clear, benefit-driven narratives, and build deep expertise in your product area.
Partner closely with Product, and with Engineering or Data Science where relevant, to determine product market fit, TAM, and opportunity cost of decisions.
Build and lead launch strategies for your focus area, in partnership with the Director.
Deliver content to GTM teams, including Demand Gen and RevOps, to drive awareness, adoption, and revenue impact.
Own product-vs-product and roadmap-vs-roadmap competitive intelligence for your focus area.
Act as an ambassador for your focus area at conferences, in web content, and in customer-facing material.
Contribute to packaging, licensing, and bundling strategy for your focus area.

SoSafe is shifting from a broad-market approach to a deliberate, segment-led GTM model. This role is central to that transition. As Manager of Segment & Solutions Marketing, you will own the positioning, messaging, and solution architecture for SoSafe's priority segments. These can be defined by geography, industry vertical, customer lifecycle stage, or Human Risk maturity.
We have a foundation to build from: a defined maturity model that maps how organisations progress in their Human Risk journey, a growing understanding of how customer needs differ across lifecycle stages and a set of priority markets and geographies. What we don't yet have is the messaging, the plays, and the product experience layer that makes those segments feel served
Your role is to and translate that work into measurable improvements in win rates, market penetration, and net revenue retention. This is a newly created role in Product Marketing that you’ll have influence to shape and will work in close partnership with GTM, Product, Sales, CS, and the Commercial Centre of Excellence.
Location: This role can be fully remote from anywhere in Germany, or hybrid from one of our offices in Cologne, Munich or Berlin .
Segmented Messaging
Own messaging for defined priority segments — including lifecycle stage (new business, upsell, cross-sell, retention), maturity tier, geography, and industry vertical (e.g. financial services, manufacturing)
Develop segment-specific value propositions written in buyer language: the situation they face, the consequence of inaction, how SoSafe solves it, and why SoSafe over alternatives without jargon, no feature lists
Use AI tools to accelerate research, messaging iteration, persona development, and competitive synthesis as a standard part of your workflow
Maintain and evolve messaging as product capabilities, customer insights, and the competitive landscape shift — keeping SoSafe's market fit current and differentiated
Monitor industry trends, regulatory developments, and competitive dynamics to proactively inform segment strategy and portfolio planning
Solution Development
Define solution sets for priority segments: which SoSafe capabilities address their most pressing needs, framed around business outcomes rather than product features
Process voice-of-customer research, win/loss data, competitive intelligence, and regulatory context into compelling segment narratives and solution architectures
Partner with the Commercial CoE to inform pricing, packaging, bundling, and programme decisions — contributing market and segment evidence to commercial recommendations that drive share within defined segments
GTM Readiness
Develop SPICED-aligned talk tracks for each priority segment, grounding rep conversations in the buyer's situation before working back to solution language
Build and maintain a library of scalable, reusable field assets e.g. solution briefs, demo scripts, battle cards, objection-handling guides, buyer and implementation guides — leveraging AI to produce, iterate, and personalise at speed
Validate messaging and demo content before market release through structured rep feedback sessions, customer interviews, and early cohort exposure
Input into coordinated multi-touch plays across Marketing, Sales, and CS that drive upsell and cross-sell into the install base — with clear pipeline and NRR impact metrics tied to each play
Track asset utilisation, field feedback, and segment performance data (win rates, pipeline velocity, NRR contribution) to continuously improve GTM effectiveness and demonstrate commercial impact
What you will bring
5+ years in B2B SaaS in product marketing, solutions marketing or segment marketing with a proven track record of producing segment-specific or lifecycle-specific positioning
Demonstrated ability to write in buyer language: situation, problem, solution, outcome - not functional feature lists
Proficiency with competitive intelligence tools and a bias towards activating insight into sales & field-facing content, enriching the quality of their conversations
Proven AI fluency: you use AI tools daily to compress research cycles, pressure-test messaging, generate content variations, and move from insight to asset faster than a traditional workflow allows
Strong cross-functional operating skills, able to align Product, Sales, CS, and Commercial stakeholders around a segment strategy and drive execution

Experience in cybersecurity, HR tech or a similarly technical B2B environment
Experience defining or contributing to solution sets and commercial packaging, not just messaging deliverables.
Background in structured pre-launch validation: rep councils, messaging test sessions, early cohort feedback

## Your Purpose ##
The Retail Marketing & Client Engagement Manager is responsible for developing and executing the retail activation strategy across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys, with the objective of increasing guest engagement, driving boutique traffic and supporting commercial performance.
The role creates and manages the onboard retail activation calendar, including events, micro-events, brand animations, VIP experiences and local initiatives designed to enhance the guest journey and maximize retail opportunities.
Working closely with Retail Leadership, Category Managers, onboard teams, CRM, Marketing and luxury brand partners, the role transforms retail strategies into memorable experiences that generate customer engagement, conversion and loyalty.

**Retail Activation Strategy**
* Define and manage the global retail activation framework across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.
* Develop an annual activation calendar aligned with commercial priorities, seasonality, itineraries, and guest profiles.
* Create initiatives that drive boutique traffic, customer engagement, and sales performance.
* Balance major events with agile onboard activations.
* Ensure all activations reflect the positioning of each brand.
**Event & Experience Management**
* Develop and execute onboard retail events, including product launches, brand showcases, VIP experiences, collection previews, and seasonal activations.
* Manage event concepts, timelines, logistics, and execution.
* Partner with luxury brands to leverage expertise, ambassadors, and activation resources.
* Measure event performance and implement improvements.
**Traffic Generation & Commercial Activation**
* Develop initiatives that increase boutique visitation and customer engagement.
* Create activation plans around new products, hero items, seasonal moments, itineraries, guest segments, and special occasions.
* Partner with Retail Operations to convert activations into commercial results.
* Introduce innovative approaches to attract diverse guest profiles.
**VIP & Client Engagement**
* Develop VIP engagement strategies with CRM and onboard teams.
* Create personalized retail experiences for high value guests.
* Support clienteling initiatives, including private appointments, exclusive previews, tailored product recommendations, and luxury brand experiences.
* Strengthen guest loyalty and encourage repeat purchases.
**Local & Destination Based Activations**
* Develop activations tailored to destinations, itineraries, and guest profiles.
* Build partnerships with relevant local stakeholders where appropriate.
* Adapt activation strategies to regional opportunities.
* Integrate destination storytelling into retail experiences.
**Brand Partner Collaboration**
* Partner with luxury and premium brands to deliver joint activations and events.
* Manage brand participation and execution standards onboard.
* Ensure alignment between brand objectives and MSC / Explora commercial priorities.
* Coordinate all required brand assets and activation requirements.
**Content & Communication Coordination**
* Collaborate with Marketing, CRM, and onboard teams to maximize activation visibility.
* Support the development of invitations, digital communications, onboard announcements, guest messaging, and promotional materials.
* Ensure consistent storytelling across all guest touchpoints.
**Performance Measurement**
* Define and track KPIs including attendance, traffic, sales uplift, conversion, engagement, and VIP participation.
* Analyze results and continuously optimize activation strategies.
* Share best practices and successful initiatives across the fleet.
**Cross Functional Collaboration**
* Work closely with the VP Global Retail & Luxury, Retail Operations, Category Management, Visual Merchandising, Training, and onboard leadership teams.
* Ensure retail activations support broader commercial and guest experience objectives.
## Your Journey so far ##
* 7+ years of experience in retail marketing, luxury events, client engagement or experiential marketing.
* Experience within luxury retail, travel retail, hospitality or premium brands.
* Proven experience creating and executing customer engagement initiatives.
* Strong experience managing events, partnerships and commercial activations.
* Experience working with luxury brands and VIP clientele is highly desirable
## Your Essentials ##
* Strong understanding of luxury customer experience and experiential retail.
* Excellent project management and event execution skills.
* Strong commercial mindset with ability to link activation to business results.
* Creative thinker with ability to develop engaging concepts.
* Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple projects in an international environment.
* Strong understanding of CRM, clienteling and customer engagement principles.
* Fluent English; additional languages are an advantage.
* Willingness to travel internationally and onboard vessels.

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Viele gute Gründe sprechen für Miele. Seit Gründung im Jahr 1899 folgt Miele seinem Markenversprechen "Immer besser". Gemeint ist: Wir setzen alles daran, "Immer besser" zu sein als alle anderen Anbieter und "Immer besser" zu werden, als wir bereits sind.

Für unsere Kunden bedeutet dies die beruhigende Gewissheit, dass sie mit Miele eine gute Entscheidung getroffen haben - wahrscheinlich eine fürs Leben. Und dieses Versprechen geben wir auch unseren Mitarbeiter:innen. Wir suchen Dich, eine teamfähige Persönlichkeit mit Hands-on-Mentalität, um gemeinsam -Immer besser- zu werden.

Lead-gen and local service first. Most of the book is graded on cost per qualified phone call, not ROAS. If ROAS and shopping feeds are all you have done, this is a harder fit.
Sound judgment on small samples. You know why "40 clicks, no conversions" is usually not a reason to pause anything, and you can explain what would change your mind.
You can explain a bidding strategy, not just set one. Target CPA and target ROAS, and what happens when a target is too tight versus too loose.
You understand offline conversion imports. Why Google Ads and a client's booking system disagree, and which one you optimize against.
Call tracking experience, CallRail preferred. Every account here is graded on tracked phone calls, so the call data is the scoreboard, not a side report.
You already work with AI and you want more of it. This is not a culture question, it is the job. We use Claude and Claude Code every day and you would too. Not an engineer: someone who reaches for these tools by instinct and can say what they have actually built with them.
You think in portfolios. Forty accounts is not forty craft projects. What works has to be systematized, not hand-tuned shop by shop.
Very fluent English, spoken and written. Hard requirement, no exceptions. You will interview shop owners and explain technical findings to non-technical people. We test this on a live call, not from a CV.
Willing to say "I do not know yet, let me check." Our worst outcomes have all come from confident wrong answers.
No certifications needed. Not a fit if you want to own client relationships, or want part-time alongside other retainers.
Read this part first, because it is what makes the job unusual: this is not one big account. It is twenty to forty small ones. A typical shop spends $1,000 to $4,000 a month. The largest spends about $7,800.
At those budgets you rarely have enough data to test your way to an answer. Forty clicks and no conversion is not evidence that a keyword is dead. Most of this job is making sound decisions on thin data, at volume, without fooling yourself. If your experience is one large account where you could run a clean experiment every fortnight, this will be an uncomfortable fit and we would rather you knew now.
You will not be an account manager. We are hiring one of those separately. No monthly review calls, no chasing invoices. You own performance.

Performance across the whole book. Campaign structure, bidding strategy, budget allocation, negative keywords, and knowing when to scale versus protect.
The decisions the system escalates. Twice a week you work a board of flagged items and rule on them. Early on you stage those rulings for review; once you have earned it, you rule and we read the log.
Measurement. Conversion tracking, GA4 and GTM, call tracking, offline conversion imports. When the numbers look wrong you find out why before anyone changes a bid.
Technical discovery for new shops. You interview the owner about what they do and do not do, their service radius, their seasonality. That produces the service definition our automation runs on.

Make the CRM the heartbeat of the commercial organisation by month 6. Every lead entering with a defined source and campaign attribution, qualification criteria in place, MQLs and SQLs tracked, and dashboards showing pipeline contribution by campaign and channel.

Own performance marketing end to end, measured on cost per qualified lead, cost per target account engaged, conversion to sales conversation and pipeline generated. Not on vanity metrics.
Make marketing a predictable contributor to pipeline within 12 months, with a recurring cadence between Marketing, Sales and Customer Success that turns deployments into customer insight, case studies, campaigns and new leads.
